source_text: Yeah, the grouping / merging process is a good case for some pattern-based programming in its own right, e.g., library/pattern-coherence could be "compiled" into something classical (like 小象) so that we can scan proposed patterns.  For example I have noticed some of the patterns that are were coming through on my starship-style prompt were negatively framed, and I'd like to be able to alter them as they come up.  TBH I think the best thing to build here is the 2-up display, and the old chatgpt-shell UI could potentially be used for inspiration here
